title: MY MALL
content: So I’ve just discovered this thread and I’m quite spiritually awakend but I am SHOOK that this is a thing I thought I was just having a dreams around this specific shopping centre from my childhood (I moved to Australia in 2015) but I never thought that there was a whole community of people expecting the same thing. So I thought I’d share the mall that seems to have influenced my mall world in case it can give a visual reference for some. There is also some very interesting architecture i can remember such as the one statue above. The food court picture is old but as I rember and had a child play area underneath and water features all throughout. In my dreams it’s all mixed up with the places and situations you all have experienced ; School, University, airport, train station/bus, theme park, water park, bars, fairs, zoo, aqaurum and surrounded by city scape with beaches and forests and sand cliffs ect.. im almost always evading capture of some sort and trying to help others get always from being ‘trapped’ by the groups in charge. Usually trying to get out of the dorms. I can fly, ‘kill’ the bad in control people, and recently heard about cloaking wich I can do by putting my hands to my head - professor x style - and trying not to be seen - hide on the ceiling and gtfo there. I also visited the beach side resort town with studio/cabin apartments a few nights ago and found it was again a trap and managed to sneak out on a cruise like ship but ended up in an Asian mall and city that I had never been to before. Anyone else have a specific real life place that their mall world centres around?
